title: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.14942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. translated_title: 通过多模态训练在纯文本推理中涌现出“视觉化思维”
translated_abstract: 多模态训练是否会塑造语言模型的思考方式，即使其输入仅为文本？我们通过针对性的因果消融实验对这一问题进行了验证，实验涵盖来自6个模型家族的10种多模态配置，并使用匹配的纯文本骨干模型以及跨家族迁移对照。我们对比了两类任务：需要构建心理场景的空间想象任务，以及仅凭符号规则即可解决的符号操作任务。我们在隐状态空间中识别出一条“视觉-语言轴”，并在推理阶段消融其投影。在Chameleon-7B模型上，该消融使BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）导航任务的准确率下降27.6个百分点，而布尔表达式任务保持不受影响（+5.6个百分点），形成33.2个百分点的双重分离。该效应具有方向特异性和层级局部性，并延伸至心理旋转、折纸和心理视角转换等心理模拟任务，且无法用任务难度、推理深度或序列更新负载来解释。总之，这些结果揭示了纯文本推理中涌现出的、由视觉塑造的思维方式。
tldr: 本研究通过因果消融实验发现，多模态训练会在语言模型隐状态空间中形成一条“视觉-语言轴”，即使输入纯文本，消融该轴也会选择性地损害心理想象类任务的推理能力，证明多模态训练使模型涌现出了“视觉化”的思维方式。
en_tdlr: Multimodal training induces an emergent vision-language axis in hidden-state space, such that ablating it selectively disrupts mental-imagery reasoning even for text-only inputs, revealing that multimodal training shapes vision-like thinking in language models.
